root_text:
Prevention & Treatment:

No specific antiviral or vaccine
Manage symptoms with rest, hydration, & OTC meds

Severe cases may require oxygen or IV fluids
Stay calm, stay informed, and follow expert advice. #HMPV #PublicHealth
